title: About Where the Ink Steps Forward
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 3 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @billdifferen: been going thru a buncha archived syrian cassette tapes and look at how sick.... A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Where the Ink Steps Forward: Landscape printed-paper assemblage: one offset cluster of salmon collar, rounded shoulders and dotted navy tie beneath receding-hair and thin-glasses fragments; an unequal, enlarged pale-cyan face dissolves behind it. A displaced pale spine interrupts their overlap. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Exposed cream printed strip between the salmon portrait and cyan face and Cream printed overlap between the two portrait fragments.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
